# 开放与静止定理：跨过围住所立者的步，所立者的总水平不上升，任何水平变化都使它下降；每步立着的有限多、生起者体现的平衡耗散世界被围住时归于静止，世界本身不必有限；八个前提既不决定被围住，也不决定开放 / Openness and the rest theorem: across steps enclosed around what stands, the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it; a balanced, dissipative world with finitely many standing at each step, whose arising is embodied, comes to rest once enclosed, the world itself need not be finite; the eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness

## 主张 Claim

每步立着的条件被不重复地列出时（Web.StandingCensus），称一步围住所立者，当某个不重复、跨过该步封闭的家族包含该步前后立着的每个条件（Flow.AroundStanding）。在平衡与耗散之下，跨过这样的步，所立者的总水平下降至少为取用该家族的形成数（standing_runs_down），所以不上升（standing_never_rises）；任何条件的水平上升或下降都使它下降（change_lowers）：上升被给予，而那里给予需要取用；下降被取用（fall_lowers_on）。所以从某步起每步都围住所立者时，没有条件的水平在任意晚的步变化（stills）；每一步的围住只需不被否定，因为比较的是自然数。读于世界：所立者被列出、生起者体现、平衡、耗散且从某步起每步围住所立者时，生起停止（World.arising_stops）。静止定理：有活动的普查（活动可判定）与所立者的普查、生起者体现、流平衡且耗散的世界，从某步起每步都围住所立者时，生起与止息都不复现（World.comes_to_rest）：水平不再变化，所以体现的生起停止；在普查之下止息复现需要生起复现（ceasing-needs-arising），所以止息也停止。两种普查都不可少：dusk 中没有任何东西立着、没有流，满足其余每个前提，每步都围住所立者，而止息复现（World.rest_needs_census）；kindling 中活跃的被列出、生起者体现、平衡、耗散、每步围住每个曾活跃的关系项，而每个未燃的燃料都立着，所立者不能被列出，生起不息；ember 是同一流而每个关系项体现，每步被围住，没有普查，生起不息（World.rest_needs_standing）。所以世界本身不必有限，但每步立着的须有限多。它的情形：有限世界列出所立者，每步都围住它（World.Finite.standing），所以 World.rests 是有限情形（World.Finite.comes_to_rest）；每个关系项都体现时，活动的普查就是所立者的普查，活动由水平判定（World.rests_around）；被围住的步不是不围住所立者（Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not），所以从某步起每步都被围住即可，不需要判定相等（World.rests_enclosed）。反过来读，这样的世界生起不息时，并非从某步起每步都被围住：与每个有限家族之外交换（World.arising_opens）。八个前提既不决定被围住，也不决定开放：Handing 的两侧另外在每步从无限多个地关系项各取一个单位再还回，满足 Becoming.Premises 的全部八个前提，生起不息；没有一步被围住，所以只在被围住的步上约束的耗散在任何一步都不约束（World.exposed_world）；它的总水平每步都是一，持有者每步下降，地的关系项水平为零（World.exposed_standing）；始终活跃的互利者满足全部八个而每步都被围住，归于静止（World.openness_contingent）；每个前提都起约束的 brood（map-of-premises 的 brood_binds）中子代生起、亲代止息，之后每步都被围住，世界不有限而归于静止（World.brood_rests）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Where what stands at each step is listed, each once (Web.StandingCensus), a step is enclosed around what stands when some family without repetition, closed across the step, holds every condition standing before or after it (Flow.AroundStanding). Under balance and dissipation, across such a step the total standing falls by at least the number of formations taking from that family (standing_runs_down), so it does not rise (standing_never_rises), and any condition's standing rising or falling lowers it (change_lowers): a rise is given to, and giving needs uptake there; a fall is taken from (fall_lowers_on). So where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps (stills); each enclosure need only be not refuted, since what is compared are numbers. Read of worlds: where what stands is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, arising stops (World.arising_stops). The rest theorem: a world with a census of what is active (its activity decided) and of what stands, whose arising is embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow, in which every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, comes to rest: neither arising nor ceasing recurs (World.comes_to_rest). Standing stops changing, so embodied arising stops; under a census recurring ceasing needs recurring arising (ceasing-needs-arising), so ceasing stops too. Both censuses are needed: in dusk nothing stands and nothing flows, every other premise holds, every step is enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs (World.rest_needs_census); in kindling what is active is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step is enclosed around every relatum ever active, yet every unburnt fuel stands, so what stands cannot be listed, and arising never ceases; in ember, the same flow with every relatum embodied, every step is enclosed, nothing active can be listed, and arising never ceases (World.rest_needs_standing). So the world itself need not be finite, but finitely many must stand at each step. Its cases: a finite world lists what stands and is enclosed around it at every step (World.Finite.standing), so World.rests is the finite case (World.Finite.comes_to_rest); where every relatum is embodied, the census of what is active lists what stands and activity is decided by standing (World.rests_around); an enclosed step is not not enclosed around what stands (Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not), so enclosure from some step on suffices, with no decision of equality (World.rests_enclosed). Read the other way, arising without end in such a world is incompatible with every step from some step on being enclosed: it exchanges beyond every finite family (World.arising_opens). The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness: the sides of Handing, also taking a unit from each of infinitely many ground relata and giving it back at every step, meet all eight premises of Becoming.Premises and keep arising without end; no step is enclosed, so dissipation, which binds only at enclosed steps, binds at none (World.exposed_world); its total standing is one at every step, the holder falling across each, and the ground relata stand at nothing (World.exposed_standing); mutualists active throughout meet all eight with every step enclosed and come to rest (World.openness_contingent); in brood, where every premise binds (brood_binds of map-of-premises), the child arises and the parent ceases, every step is enclosed, and the world, though not finite, comes to rest (World.brood_rests). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 水平的规律（stills）：平衡；耗散；所立者的普查（每步立着的条件被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个立着）；从某步起每步都围住所立者。 / The standing law (stills): balance; dissipation; a census of what stands (the conditions standing at each step listed, each once, so finitely many stand at each step); every step from some step on enclosed around what stands.
- 读于世界。生起停止（arising_stops）：所立者的普查与生起者体现。静止定理（comes_to_rest）：另加活动的普查与活动可判定。rests_around、rests_enclosed、arising_opens：活动的普查与每个关系项都体现，二者给出所立者的普查与活动的判定；不要求判定相等。 / Read of worlds. Arising stops (arising_stops): a census of what stands and whatever arises embodied. The rest theorem (comes_to_rest): also a census of what is active, with activity decided. rests_around, rests_enclosed, arising_opens: a census of what is active and every relatum embodied, which together give the census of what stands and decide activity; no decision of equality is needed.
- exposed_world、exposed_standing、openness_contingent、rest_needs_census 与 rest_needs_standing 是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提。 / exposed_world, exposed_standing, openness_contingent, rest_needs_census and rest_needs_standing are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

§30 的 rests 用有限使世界归于静止；本结果说明世界本身不必有限：起作用的是每步立着的有限多（两种普查），连同被围住所立者；有限世界在两点上起作用，给出普查，也给出被围住，这两点可以分开要求。kindling 与 ember 说明每步立着的有限多不能去掉，dusk 说明活动的普查不能去掉，exposed 说明被围住不能去掉。rests 与这里的 rests_around 是同一个静止定理的两种情形（P26）：有限世界自动有两种普查并且每步都被围住，每个关系项都体现的世界中两种普查是同一个。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在平衡与耗散之下，所立者的总水平是一个只降不升的量；每次生起（体现时就是开始作为条件而在）与每次止息（体现时就是不再作为条件而在）都使它下降，所以在一个被围住、每步立着的有限多的展开中，变化只能有限多次。生起不息因此需要开放：并非从某步起每步都被围住，即与每个有限家族之外交换。这是 §17、§20 中家族层面的“开放”在世界层面的陈述，并且用变化的所立者列表而不是固定的家族。在世界层面，开放是在每个有限家族之外的交换，不必有流入：exposed 的交换净量为零，总水平始终为一，无界的是与之交换的关系项的数目，各自水平为零；“开放”指交换还是流入由 Ren 选择。exposed 中活动需要支持与有界传递因为没有依存而空成立，耗散因为没有一步被围住而空成立；静止定理只用其中四个前提。耗散只约束被围住的交换是其表示的已披露的特点（§22 的 Spray）。“开放”“被围住”“所立者”的读法与名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定；本结果不评价开放或静止。 / Section 30's rests brings a world to rest through finiteness; this result shows that the world itself need not be finite: what does the work is finitely many standing at each step (the two censuses), with enclosure around what stands; finiteness works in two ways, giving the censuses and giving enclosure, and the two can be asked for separately. kindling and ember show that finitely many standing at each step cannot be dropped, dusk that the census of what is active cannot, and exposed that enclosure cannot. rests and rests_around here are two cases of one rest theorem (P26): a finite world has both censuses and is enclosed at every step, and where every relatum is embodied the two censuses are one. The author's reading (an AI argument): under balance and dissipation the total standing is a quantity that falls and never rises; every arising (for an embodied relatum, coming to stand) and every ceasing (for an embodied relatum, ceasing to stand) lowers it, so in an unfolding enclosed and with finitely many standing at each step, change happens only finitely often. Arising without end therefore needs openness: not every step from some step on enclosed, that is, exchange beyond every finite family. This is the family-level openness of sections 17 and 20 stated of worlds, over the changing list of what stands rather than a fixed family. At world level openness is exchange beyond every finite family and need not be inflow: exposed exchanges at zero net, its total standing stays at one, and what is unbounded is the number of relata it exchanges with, each at zero; whether ‘openness’ names exchange or inflow is Ren's to choose. In exposed, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously, since nothing depends on anything, and dissipation holds vacuously, since no step is enclosed; the rest theorem uses four premises. That dissipation binds only enclosed exchange is a disclosed feature of its representation (section 22's Spray). The readings and names of ‘openness’, ‘enclosed’ and ‘what stands’ are the AI's formulations and Ren's to choose; the result evaluates neither openness nor rest.

静止定理只要求生起者体现，但要求活动的普查、所立者的普查与活动可判定（逻辑承诺）；rests_around、rests_enclosed 与 arising_opens 要求每个关系项体现；exposed 中三个前提空成立，这是耗散只约束被围住的交换这一表示特点，而不是对实际开放系统的描述；只对离散步与自然数的量陈述；不评价开放或静止；名称由 Ren 定。 / The rest theorem needs only whatever arises to be embodied, but needs a census of what is active, a census of what stands and decided activity (a logical commitment); rests_around, rests_enclosed and arising_opens need every relatum embodied; in exposed three premises hold vacuously, a feature of representing dissipation as binding only enclosed exchange, not a description of actual open systems; stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; evaluates neither openness nor rest; names are Ren's to choose.

**Preserved conditions / 保留条件:** 活动的普查；活动可判定。 / A census of what is active; decided activity. [Population.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [space-and-its-parts](space-and-its-parts.md). 那里的 rests 以有限为前提；静止定理以普查与被围住代替有限，rests 是它的有限情形（World.Finite.comes_to_rest，P26）。 / rests there assumes finiteness; the rest theorem replaces finiteness with censuses and enclosure, and rests is its finite case (World.Finite.comes_to_rest, P26).
